name: Catecholamine synthesis
summary: Adrenal medulla and catecholaminergic neurons. Tyrosine hydroxylase is rate-limiting. Cofactors worth knowing at each step: BH₄, BH₄, B6, vitamin C (+ copper), SAM. Breakdown (MAO, COMT): dopamine → homovanillic acid; norepinephrine/epinephrine → normetanephrine/metanephrine → vanillylmandelic acid.

dopa.name: L-DOPA
dopa.notes: Crosses the blood–brain barrier; dopamine doesn't.

epi.name: Epinephrine
epi.notes: Broken down to metanephrine and VMA. Pheochromocytoma: ↑ plasma free metanephrines.

tyr.name: Tyrosine
tyr.notes: Also → thyroid hormones and melanin (tyrosinase; albinism).

ne.name: Norepinephrine
ne.notes: Broken down to normetanephrine and VMA.

pah.name: Phenylalanine hydroxylase
pah.notes: Deficiency (or BH₄ deficiency, e.g. dihydropteridine reductase) → phenylketonuria: tyrosine becomes essential; musty odor, fair skin, intellectual disability. Maternal PKU → microcephaly, cardiac defects.

th.name: Tyrosine hydroxylase
th.notes: Rate-limiting step of catecholamine synthesis. Inhibited by metyrosine.

ddc.name: DOPA decarboxylase
ddc.notes: Needs B6. Carbidopa blocks it peripherally so more L-DOPA reaches the brain.

dbh.name: Dopamine β-hydroxylase
dbh.notes: Inside secretory vesicles; needs vitamin C and copper (Menkes disease lowers it). Disulfiram inhibits it via copper chelation.

pnmt.name: Phenylethanolamine N-methyltransferase
pnmt.notes: Adrenal medulla. Methyl group from SAM. Induced by cortisol arriving via the adrenal portal circulation.

lat1.name: LAT1
lat1.notes: Tyrosine reaches the adrenal medulla and neurons in the blood (from the diet or the liver) and enters through LAT1, the large neutral amino acid carrier that also takes L-DOPA across the blood–brain barrier.

vmat.name: VMAT (vesicular monoamine transporter)
vmat.notes: Pumps dopamine, norepinephrine, epinephrine and serotonin into vesicles in exchange for protons (VMAT2 in neurons, VMAT1 in chromaffin cells). Reserpine blocks it irreversibly; tetrabenazine blocks VMAT2.

neleak.name: Leaks out of the vesicle
neleak.notes: In adrenal chromaffin cells some norepinephrine leaks from the vesicles into the cytosol, where PNMT (induced by cortisol from the cortex) makes epinephrine.
